semantics.ordinary: multiply each ancestor and local element opacity exactly once
semantics.intrinsic: multiply primitive intrinsic alpha by binding opacity and inherited element opacity exactly once
semantics.siblings: restore ancestor opacity on scope exit
semantics.deferred: start each deferred group at opacity one; apply that group subtree local opacities
semantics.zero: transparent solids may be culled from scene; layout and mouse target remain
semantics.compositing: per primitive alpha, not isolated group compositing
semantics.clipping: ordinary descendant clip intersects parent viewport; parent background remains outside own child clip

projection.zero_alpha: omit alpha-zero candidate solid commands, retaining raw command values
projection.fully_clipped: omit candidate commands whose bounds do not intersect current content mask
projection.quad_order: Retain raw backend scene order. Compare all primitive fields by unique authored color identity, plus direction of every overlapping visible-rectangle pair. Only disjoint quads may commute (GPUI Scene::finish/bounds_tree).

limitations: Not a complete port of opacity.rs; catalog implemented count does not change.
No pixels, native renderer, assets, images, SVG, GIF, text, shadows or hover animation qualification.
Deferred and clipped fixtures are separate because production anchored composition rejects scroll viewports.
